items.title: Albert Glenny Interview, 1957-03-27
items.q: Hey, Ron. Peter on Peter, that's right. Oh, God, I only called him this club.

ctx.x: There's one place called Tranchino's or something. What? Tranchino's.

Tranchino's. Tranchino's. I played that too already, but I know that too. Hey, Ron played that. Huh? Hey, Ron. Peter on Peter, that's right. Oh, God, I only called him this club. What used to happen out at Millenburg? Huh? What used to happen out at Millenburg? I never was there. What used to happen? Well, they had plenty of camps out there. I played out there regularly. You know, so many job differences. They get picnics at camps out there, paper white, paper colored. And every Sunday, 9 o'clock train, 15 cents…
The lawn party was right outdoors. You eat red beans? Oh, yeah.
